    • getClock

      public Optional<Duration> getClock(StatisticsKey key, @Nullable Object owner)
      Description copied from interface: StatisticsService
      Returns the current value of the clock with the given key for the given owner. If owner is null, all values for the given key will be aggregated via addition.

      Note that clocks need to be paused before the duration of elapsed time is available.

      Specified by:
      getClock in interface StatisticsService
      Parameters:
      key - the key for looking up the clock
      owner - the (optional) owner that stored the clock
      Returns:
      the duration of the clock, or Optional.empty() if no clock for this key and owner exists
